title: Orlando City Lights and Fireworks Premier Helicopter Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience a once-in-a-lifetime evening aerial view of world-famous theme parks and attractions over Orlando with an incredible Fireworks Show Finale at Epcot!

This unique excursion is fun for all ages and provides spectacular nighttime views in air-conditioned luxury. For the adventurer, the novelty-seeker, or the person who's done 'everything'!
